zhDesc: 耶诺之护符是已知最强大的神器，其来源不明。据说，只要主人的意志足够坚定，能「说服」它，这枚护符就能实现任何愿望。
enDesc: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful known artifact of unknown origin. It is said that the amulet is able to fulfil any wish if its owner's will-power is strong enough to "persuade" it to do it.

zhDesc: 这枚古老的不朽象征赋予你死而复生的能力。复活时，所有未装备的物品都会遗失。
enDesc: The ancient symbol of immortality grants an ability to return to life after death. Upon resurrection all non-equipped items are lost.

zhConsts.TXT_EQUIP_CURSED: 你的%s紧紧勒住你，痛得你龇牙咧嘴
zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: 不同种类魔法的相互作用抹去了这件护甲上的印记！

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: you are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: Interaction of different types of magic has erased the glyph on this armor!

zhDesc: 用这套小工具和材料，任何人都能把一件护甲改造成「专属护甲」。它会保留原护甲的全部属性，还会根据穿戴者的职业赋予一项特殊能力。裁缝、皮革加工或锻造的技能一概不需要。
enDesc: Using this kit of small tools and materials anybody can transform any armor into an "epic armor", which will keep all properties of the original armor, but will also provide its wearer a special ability depending on his class. No skills in tailoring, leatherworking or blacksmithing are required.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_ARMOR: 选择一件护甲进行改造
zhConsts.TXT_UPGRADED: 你用护甲改造套件升级了你的%s

enConsts.TXT_UPGRADED: you applied the armor kit to upgrade your %s

zhDesc: 这把战斧巨大的钢制斧头，让每一次挥砍都力道十足。
enDesc: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each stroke.

zhDesc: 这是一颗体积不大的炸弹，里面装满了黑火药。方便的是，它被扔出去时引信会自动点燃。
enDesc: This is a relatively small bomb, filled with black powder. Conveniently, its fuse is lit automatically when the bomb is thrown.

zhDesc: 这种扁平弯曲的木制投掷物掷向敌人后，会自行飞回投掷者手中。
enDesc: Thrown to the enemy this flat curved wooden missile will return to the hands of its thrower.

zhDesc: 看起来是块像样的肉排。
enDesc: It looks like a decent steak.

zhDesc: 这东西看起来酷毙了！
enDesc: The thing looks awesome!

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_EQUIPPED: 你必须穿着这件护甲才能使用它的特殊能力！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_EQUIPPED: You need to be wearing this armor to use its special power!

zhDesc: 这件轻便的护甲只能提供最基础的防护。
enDesc: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.

zhDesc: 这团尸尘外表与普通灰尘没什么两样。但你就是知道，最好尽快把它处理掉。
enDesc: The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. However, you know somehow that it's better to get rid of it as soon as possible.

zhDesc: 这些小小的邪恶飞镖伤害不高，却能让目标麻痹，在一段时间内无助地动弹不得。
enDesc: These little evil darts don't do much damage but they can paralyze the target leaving it helpless and motionless for some time.

zhDesc: 一把朴素的铁质匕首，木柄已经磨得发亮。
enDesc: A simple iron dagger with a well worn wooden handle.

zhDesc: 这种金属之所以叫暗金，不是因为颜色（它跟普通黄金毫无区别），而是因为它在日光下会熔化，因此在地面上毫无用处。
enDesc: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.

zhDesc: 这些简单的金属尖刺经过配重，能笔直飞行，手腕一抖便可刺中猎物。
enDesc: These simple metal spikes are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist.

zhDesc: 你可以把多余的露水装进这个小瓶，留着以后喝。如果瓶子是满的，在生死关头露水会被自动喝下。
enDesc: You can store excess dew in this tiny vessel for drinking it later. If the vial is full, in a moment of deadly peril the dew will be consumed automatically.

zhConsts.TXT_AUTO_DRINK: 露水瓶被喝空，治愈了你的伤口。
zhConsts.TXT_COLLECTED: 你收集了一滴露水装进露水瓶。

enConsts.TXT_AUTO_DRINK: The dew vial was emptied to heal your wounds.
enConsts.TXT_COLLECTED: You collected a dewdrop into your dew vial.

zhDesc: 一滴清澈透明的露水。
enDesc: A crystal clear dewdrop.

zhDesc: 玫瑰早就干枯了，但不知怎么，花瓣一片都没掉。
enDesc: The rose has dried long ago, but it has kept all its petals somehow.

zhDesc: 许多矮人，以及他们造出的一些大型造物，都随身带着这种用途不明的小金属片。也许是首饰，也许是某种身份证件。矮人真是奇怪的家伙。
enDesc: Many dwarves and some of their larger creations carry these small pieces of metal of unknown purpose. Maybe they are jewelry or maybe some kind of ID. Dwarves are strange folk.

zhDesc: 没什么特别的：肉干、几块饼干之类的东西。
enDesc: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.

zhDesc: 这是一块冻硬的生肉。唯一的吃法是切下薄薄的薄片。这样吃意外的不错。
enDesc: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's suprisingly good.

zhDesc: 一种长柄兵器，在长杆末端装上剑刃。
enDesc: A polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.

zhConsts.TXT_COLLECT: 收集金币，以后好在商店里花掉。

enConsts.TXT_COLLECT: Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.

zhDesc: 这把金钥匙的齿纹细密而精巧。也许它能打开某个箱子上的锁？
enDesc: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Maybe it can open some chest lock?

zhDesc: 这个小蜜罐里蜂蜜不多，但里面住着一只金色蜜蜂，而且它并不想离开。
enDesc: There is not much honey in this small honeypot, but there is a golden bee there and it doesn't want to leave it.

zhDesc: 穿上这件斗篷的女猎手能唤出一扇扇形的光刃。每一片光刃都会锁定女猎手视野中的一名敌人，造成的伤害取决于她当前装备的近战武器。
enDesc: A huntress in such cloak can create a fan of spectral blades. Each of these blades will target a single enemy in the huntress's field of view, inflicting damage depending on her currently equipped melee weapon.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_HUNTRESS: 只有女猎手能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_HUNTRESS: Only huntresses can use this armor!

zhDesc: 每支飞镖的尖刺用来把它钉在目标身上，同时绑在镖身上的不稳定化合物会爆发出耀眼的火焰。
enDesc: The spike on each of these darts is designed to pin it to its target while the unstable compounds strapped to its length burst into brilliant flames.

zhConsts.TXT_WARNING: 你真的要取消这次卷轴使用吗？无论如何它都会被消耗掉。

enConsts.TXT_WARNING: Do you really want to cancel this scroll usage? It will be consumed anyway.

zhConsts.TXT_FROM_DEPTH: 来自第 %d 层的铁钥匙

zhConsts.TXT_PACK_FULL: 你的背包太满了，装不下%s
zhConsts.TXT_BROKEN: 由于频繁使用，你的%s已经损坏。
zhConsts.TXT_GONNA_BREAK: 由于频繁使用，你的%s很快就要坏了。

enConsts.TXT_PACK_FULL: Your pack is too full for the %s
enConsts.TXT_BROKEN: Because of frequent use, your %s has broken.
enConsts.TXT_GONNA_BREAK: Because of frequent use, your %s is going to break soon.

zhDesc: 这根金属长杆经过配重，使尖端在飞行途中始终朝前。
enDesc: This length of metal is weighted to keep the spike at its tip foremost as it sails through the air.

zhDesc: 这是一枚铜制钥匙环，让你把钥匙和其余物品分开存放。
enDesc: This is a copper key ring, that lets you keep all your keys separately from the rest of your belongings.

enConsts.TXT_EQUIP_CURSED: you wince as your grip involuntarily tightens around your %s

zhDesc: 一块贴合指关节形状的铁块。
enDesc: A piece of iron shaped to fit around the knuckles.

zhDesc: 用鞣制过的怪物皮革制成的护甲。不如布甲轻便，但防护更好。
enDesc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.

zhDesc: 劳埃德信标是一件精巧的魔法装置，能让你回到曾经去过的地方。
enDesc: {TXT_INFO}{returnDepth}{Utils.format}{TXT_SET}{returnDepth}

zhConsts.TXT_PREVENTING: 此地强大的魔力场让你无法使用劳埃德信标！
zhConsts.TXT_CREATURES: 邻近生物的心灵力场让你此刻无法使用劳埃德信标。
zhConsts.TXT_RETURN: 劳埃德信标已成功设置在你当前的位置，现在你可以随时回到这里。
zhConsts.TXT_INFO: 劳埃德信标是一件精巧的魔法装置，能让你回到一个你已经去过的地方。
zhConsts.TXT_SET: 这个信标被设置在像素地牢第 %d 层的某处。

enConsts.TXT_PREVENTING: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the lloyd's beacon!
enConsts.TXT_CREATURES: Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to use the lloyd's beacon at this moment.
enConsts.TXT_RETURN: The lloyd's beacon is successfully set at your current location, now you can return here anytime.
enConsts.TXT_INFO: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magic device, that allows you to return to a place you have already been.
enConsts.TXT_SET: This beacon was set somewhere on the level %d of Pixel Dungeon.

zhDesc: 这柄又高又重的剑刃把全部重量压进每一次劈砍，能造成重伤。
enDesc: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every cut.

zhDesc: 这把武器的铁质锤头能造成相当可观的伤害。
enDesc: The iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.

zhDesc: 穿上这件华美的长袍，法师可以施展「熔岩大地」法术：视野内的所有敌人都会被点燃，同时无法移动。
enDesc: Wearing this gorgeous robe, a mage can cast a spell of molten earth: all the enemies in his field of view will be set on fire and unable to move at the same time.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_MAGE: 只有法师能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_MAGE: Only mages can use this armor!

zhDesc: 互相扣合的金属环组成了一套坚韧而灵活的护甲。
enDesc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.

zhConsts.TXT_YES: 是的，我清楚自己在做什么
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE: 你真的要把它当作近战武器来装备吗？

enConsts.TXT_YES: Yes, I know what I'm doing
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE: Do you really want to equip it as a melee weapon?

zhDesc: 吃不吃随你，后果自负！
enDesc: Eat at your own risk!

zhDesc: 看起来跟标准口粮一模一样，只是小了点。
enDesc: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.

zhDesc: 这是正宗的康沃尔馅饼，传统的牛肉加土豆馅。
enDesc: This is authentic Cornish pasty with traditional filling of beef and potato.

zhDesc: 你几乎看不见这尾在空气中半透明的小鱼。一旦进入水里，它就会彻底隐形。
enDesc: You can barely see this tiny translucent fish in the air. In the water it becomes effectively invisible.

zhDesc: 这是一把又大又结实的破岩工具。大概也能当武器使。
enDesc: This is a large and sturdy tool for breaking rocks. Probably it can be used as a weapon.

zhConsts.TXT_NO_VEIN: 你附近没有可以开采的暗金矿脉

enConsts.TXT_NO_VEIN: There is no dark gold vein near you to mine

zhDesc: 巨大的金属板拼接成一整套护甲，为任何强壮到能承受它惊人重量的冒险者提供无可比拟的防护。
enDesc: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.

zhDesc: {isKnown}{desc}这只小瓶里装着不停打旋的{color}液体。谁知道喝下去或者扔出去会发生什么？
enDesc: {isKnown}{desc}This flask contains a swirling {color} liquid. Who knows what it will do when drunk or thrown?

zhConsts.TXT_YES: 是的，我清楚自己在做什么
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_DRINK: 你确定要喝下它吗？大多数情况下，这种药水应该扔向敌人才对。
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_THROW: 你确定要扔掉它吗？大多数情况下，喝下它才是明智之举。

enConsts.TXT_YES: Yes, I know what I'm doing
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_DRINK: Are you sure you want to drink it? In most cases you should throw such potions at your enemies.
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_THROW: Are you sure you want to throw it? In most cases it makes sense to drink it.

zhDesc: 无数场战斗积淀的历练被浓缩成液体，喝下后立即提升一个经验等级。
enDesc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.

zhDesc: 这种化学物质一旦接触空气就会蒸发成冰霜云团，任何碰到它的生物都会被冻在原地，无法行动也无法移动。
enDesc: Upon exposure to open air, this chemical will evaporate into a freezing cloud, causing any creature that contacts it to be frozen in place, unable to act and move.

zhDesc: 一瓶能立刻让你恢复满生命值并解除中毒的药剂。
enDesc: An elixir that will instantly return you to full health and cure poison.

zhDesc: 喝下后你会暂时隐形，敌人将看不见你。攻击敌人，或在敌人眼前使用法杖、卷轴，都会解除这个效果。
enDesc: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Attacking an enemy, as well as using a wand or a scroll before enemy's eyes, will dispel the effect.

zhDesc: 喝下这种奇特的液体会让你悬浮在空中，可以毫不费力地飘过陷阱。不过火焰和毒气弥漫在空气中，飘着也躲不开。
enDesc: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over traps. Flames and gases fill the air, however, and cannot be bypassed while airborne.

zhDesc: 瓶里装着不稳定的化合物，一接触空气就会猛烈燃烧起来。
enDesc: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.

zhDesc: 这瓶强劲的液体会流遍你的肌肉，永久提升 1 点力量和 5 点生命上限。
enDesc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and health by five points.

zhDesc: 喝下之后，你的精神会与远处生物的心灵信号同步，让你能隔着墙壁感知生命存在。它还能让你看穿附近的墙壁和门。
enDesc: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.

zhDesc: 瓶中的液体接触空气后会汽化成麻木的黄色烟雾。吸入烟雾的人会立刻麻痹，在烟雾散去后的一段时间里仍无法移动。可以把它扔向远处的敌人，让他们笼罩在气体里。
enDesc: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.

zhDesc: 这种试剂会迅速中和作用范围内的所有有害气体。喝下它能让你在一段时间内对此类气体免疫。
enDesc: This reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful gases in the area of effect. Drinking it will give you a temporary immunity to such gases.

zhConsts.TXT_FRESHNESS: 你感到空气中有一种异样的清新。
zhConsts.TXT_NO_SMELL: 你再也闻不到任何气味了！

enConsts.TXT_FRESHNESS: You feel uncommon freshness in the air.

zhDesc: 这瓶强劲的液体会流遍你的肌肉，永久提升 1 点力量。
enDesc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.

zhDesc: 打开或摔碎这个加压玻璃瓶，里面的东西会炸成一片致命的绿色毒云。你也可以选择把它扔向远处的敌人，而不是拿在手里开瓶。
enDesc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.

zhDesc: 一根硬木长杖，两端包着铁箍。
enDesc: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.

zhDesc: 这本来会是个不错的狩猎战利品，可惜太臭了，挂不到墙上去。
enDesc: It could be a nice hunting trophy, but it smells too bad to place it on a wall.

zhDesc: {desc}  {name}正戴在你的手指上{cursed}，由于它被诅咒，你无力将它取下。
enDesc:
{desc}

The {name} is on your finger{cursed}, and because it is cursed, you are powerless to remove it..

zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_UNEQUIP_MESSAGE: 你同时只能戴两枚戒指。请取下一枚已装备的戒指。

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: you are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_UNEQUIP_MESSAGE: You can only wear two rings at a time. Unequip one of your equipped rings.

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你命中敌人的概率。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to hit the enemy.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，佩戴者无需花时间搜索就能察觉隐藏的秘密——陷阱与暗门。劣化的侦测之戒会让你的感官迟钝，即便主动搜索也更难发现秘密。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}Wearing this ring will allow the wearer to notice hidden secrets - traps and secret doors - without taking time to search. Degraded rings of detection will dull your senses, making it harder to notice secrets even when actively searching for them.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提供对不同元素的抗性，比如火焰、电流、毒气等等，同时缩短负面效果的持续时间。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring provides resistance to different elements, such as fire, electricity, gases etc. Also it decreases duration of negative effects.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你躲开敌人攻击的概率。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to dodge enemy attack.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}事实上这枚戒指没有任何魔法效果，但它能向店主和商贩表明：戒指的主人属于盗贼公会。通常他们很乐意给点折扣，换取临时的「免骚扰」保证。升级这枚戒指不会带来任何额外加成。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}In fact this ring doesn't provide any magic effect, but it demonstrates to shopkeepers and vendors, that the owner of the ring is a member of The Thieves' Guild. Usually they are glad to give a discount in exchange for temporary immunity guarantee. Upgrading this ring won't give any additional bonuses.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指加快佩戴者的时间流速，让所有动作都变得快上一点。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring accelerates the wearer's flow of time, allowing one to perform all actions a little faster.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你从踩倒的草丛中收集露水和种子的概率。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to gather dew and seeds from trampled grass.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指增强身体的再生能力，让你以更快的速度恢复损失的生命。劣化的戒指会降低甚至停止你的自然恢复。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases the body's regenerative properties, allowing one to recover lost health at an accelerated rate. Degraded rings will decrease or even halt one's natural regeneration.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}在这枚戒指辐射出的能量场中，你的法杖会变得更强大。劣化的能量之戒反而会削弱你的法杖。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}Your wands will become more powerful in the energy field that radiates from this ring. Degraded rings of power will instead weaken your wands.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，你能更久地不吃东西。劣化的饱腹之戒会产生相反的效果。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}Wearing this ring you can go without food longer. Degraded rings of satiety will cause the opposite effect.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，敌人更不容易注意到你。劣化的暗影之戒反而会惊动本不会发现你的敌人。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}Enemies will be less likely to notice you if you wear this ring. Degraded rings of shadows will alert enemies who might otherwise not have noticed your presence.{super.desc}

zhDesc: {isKnown}虽然这枚戒指并没有真正的尖刺，但攻击你的敌人会按它造成伤害的一部分反伤自身。升级这枚戒指不会带来任何额外加成。{super.desc}
enDesc: {isKnown}Though this ring doesn't provide real thorns, an enemy that attacks you will itself be wounded by a fraction of the damage that it inflicts. Upgrading this ring won't give any additional bonuses.{super.desc}

zhDesc: 穿着这件深色夜行衣，盗贼可以施展被称为「烟雾弹」的技巧（虽然并不真的用到炸药）：他会致盲所有能看见他的敌人，然后跳向一旁。
enDesc: Wearing this dark garb, a rogue can perform a trick, that is called "smoke bomb" (though no real explosives are used): he blinds enemies who could see him and jumps aside.

zhConsts.TXT_FOV: 你只能跳到视野内的空地上
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_ROGUE: 只有盗贼能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_FOV: You can only jump to an empty location in your field of view
enConsts.TXT_NOT_ROGUE: Only rogues can use this armor!

zhDesc: 缝在皮背心上的金属鳞片，造就了一件既灵活又能防身的护甲。
enDesc: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.

zhDesc: {isKnown}{desc}这张羊皮纸上写满了无法解读的文字，标题处画着{rune}符文。谁知道大声念出来会发生什么？
enDesc: {isKnown}{desc}This parchment is covered with indecipherable writing, and bears a title of rune {rune}. Who knows what it will do when read aloud?

zhConsts.TXT_BLINDED: 失明时你无法阅读卷轴

enConsts.TXT_BLINDED: You can't read a scroll while blinded

zhDesc: 你可以把任意数量的卷轴放进这个筒状容器。它节省背包空间，还能保护卷轴不被火烧毁。
enDesc: You can place any number of scrolls into this tubular container. It saves room in your backpack and protects scrolls from fire.

zhDesc: 大声念出后，这张卷轴会爆发出一声挑衅的怒吼，惊醒所有怪物，让它们注意到朗读者的位置。
enDesc: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a challenging roar that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.

zhDesc: 这张卷轴能为一把武器或一件护甲随机附上一条附魔，赋予它特殊的能力。
enDesc: This scroll is able to imbue a weapon or an armor with a random enchantment, granting it a special power.

zhConsts.TXT_GLOWS: 你的%s在黑暗中发出微光

zhDesc: 永久揭示一件物品的全部秘密。
enDesc: Permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.

zhDesc: 一段舒缓的旋律会让你视野中的所有生物陷入沉睡，给你逃跑或偷袭的机会。
enDesc: A soothing melody will put all creatures in your field of view into a deep sleep, giving you a chance to flee or make a surprise attack on them.

zhDesc: 念出这张卷轴时，一幅清晰无比的图像会刻进你的记忆，让你知晓本层的精确布局并发现所有隐藏的秘密。物品与生物的位置仍然未知。
enDesc: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.

zhConsts.TXT_LAYOUT: 你现在已经掌握了本层的布局。

enConsts.TXT_LAYOUT: You are now aware of the level layout.

zhDesc: 这张卷轴上的咒语会创造出朗读者的幻影分身，替他追击敌人。
enDesc: The incantation on this scroll will create illusionary twins of the reader, which will chase his enemies.

zhDesc: 这张卷轴蕴含着破坏性的能量，可以通过心灵引导，对视野内的所有生物造成巨大伤害。伴随的闪光还会暂时致盲作用范围内的所有人，包括朗读卷轴的人自己。
enDesc: This scroll contains destructive energy, that can be psionically channeled to inflict a massive damage to all creatures within a field of view. An accompanying flash of light will temporarily blind everybody in the area of effect including the reader of the scroll.

zhDesc: 这张羊皮纸中封存的原始魔力一旦释放，会把朗读者的所有法杖充能至满。
enDesc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, recharge all of the reader's wands to full power.

zhDesc: 这张卷轴上的咒语会立刻剥离朗读者的武器、护甲、戒指和随身物品上一切可能妨碍其卸下的邪恶诅咒。
enDesc: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.

zhConsts.TXT_PROCCED: 你的背包泛起一层净化的光，一股邪恶的能量随之消散。
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_PROCCED: 你的背包泛起一层净化的光，但什么也没有发生。

enConsts.TXT_PROCCED: Your pack glows with a cleansing light, and a malevolent energy disperses.
enConsts.TXT_NOT_PROCCED: Your pack glows with a cleansing light, but nothing happens.

zhDesc: 羊皮纸上的法术会把朗读者立刻送到本地牢层的某个随机位置。它能用来逃离险境，但运气不好的话，可能反而落进更危险的地方。
enDesc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation, but the unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.

zhConsts.TXT_TELEPORTED: 一眨眼之间，你被传送到了本层的另一处。
zhConsts.TXT_NO_TELEPORT: 此处强大的魔力场让你无法传送！

enConsts.TXT_TELEPORTED: In a blink of an eye you were teleported to another location of the level.
enConsts.TXT_NO_TELEPORT: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from teleporting!

zhDesc: 一道红光会让视野中的所有生物陷入极度恐惧，转身逃跑。攻击正在逃跑的敌人会解除这个效果。
enDesc: A flash of red light will overwhelm all creatures in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will dispel the effect.

zhDesc: 这张卷轴能升级一件物品，提升它的品质。法杖会{increase}{in}{power}{and}{in}{number}{of}{charges}
enDesc: This scroll will upgrade a single item, improving its quality. A wand will {increase}{in}{power}{and}{in}{number}{of}{charges}

zhConsts.TXT_LOOKS_BETTER: 你的%s现在看起来顺眼多了

zhDesc: 念出这张卷轴可以释放地牢亡魂的怒火，杀死当前楼层上的一切。嗯，几乎是一切。某些更强大的生物可能不受影响。
enDesc: Read this scroll to unleash the wrath of the dungeon spirits, killing everything on the current level. Well, almost everything. Some of the more powerful creatures may be not affected.

zhConsts.TXT_BLINDED: 失明时你无法阅读卷轴

enConsts.TXT_BLINDED: You can't read a scroll while blinded

zhDesc: 这只小小的天鹅绒口袋可以装下任意数量的种子。非常方便。
enDesc: This small velvet pouch allows you to store any number of seeds in it. Very convenient.

zhDesc: 它确实很短，只比匕首长几英寸。
enDesc: It is indeed quite short, just a few inches longer, than a dagger.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_WEAPON: 选择一件武器进行升级
zhConsts.TXT_REFORGED: 你重铸了短剑，用来升级你的%s
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_BOOMERANG: 你不能这样升级回旋镖

enConsts.TXT_REFORGED: you reforged the short sword to upgrade your %s
enConsts.TXT_NOT_BOOMERANG: you can't upgrade a boomerang this way

zhDesc: 星形的金属片带着剃刀般锋利的刃口，命中目标时伤害可观，而且能以极快的频率连续投掷。
enDesc: Star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades do significant damage when they hit a target. They can be thrown at very high rate.

zhDesc: 这把钥匙看起来来头不小：钥匙头做成了骷髅的形状。大概能打开某扇来头不小的门。
enDesc: This key looks serious: its head is shaped like a skull. Probably it can open some serious door.

zhDesc: 一根纤细的木杆，顶端装着一截削尖的铁。
enDesc: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.

zhDesc: 这柄锋利的钢制长刃闪着令人安心的寒光。
enDesc: The razor-sharp length of steel blade shines reassuringly.

zhDesc: 这把投掷用的斧头不算太重，但要发挥威力仍需要相当的力量。
enDesc: This throwing axe is not that heavy, but it still requires significant strength to be used effectively.

zhDesc: 这本磨损的皮面书并不算厚，但你莫名觉得能从中学到很多。不过要记住，读完这本书可能需要一些时间。
enDesc: This worn leather book is not that thick, but you feel somehow, that you can gather a lot from it. Remember though that reading this tome may require some time.

zhDesc: 在恶魔殿堂里这是不可或缺的道具，那地方以环境照明极差而臭名昭著。
enDesc: It's an indispensable item in The Demon Halls, which are notorious for their poor ambient lighting.

zhConsts.TXT_WOOD: 这根纤细的%s法杖摸上去暖暖的。谁知道使用它会发生什么？
zhConsts.TXT_DAMAGE: 把这支法杖当作近战武器时，它的平均伤害是每次 %d 点。
zhConsts.TXT_WEAPON: 你可以把这支法杖当作近战武器使用。
zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉了。

enConsts.TXT_WOOD: This thin %s wand is warm to the touch. Who knows what it will do when used?
enConsts.TXT_DAMAGE: When this wand is used as a melee weapon, its average damage is %d points per hit.
enConsts.TXT_WEAPON: You can use this wand as a melee weapon.
enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: You are now familiar enough with your %s.

zhDesc: 这个细长的皮套是用某种异域动物的皮革制成的，可以紧凑地携带最多 {size} 支法杖。
enDesc: This slim holder is made of leather of some exotic animal. It allows to compactly carry up to {size} wands.

zhDesc: 这支法杖发出的紫光会让目标陷入狂乱，攻击它附近的随机生物。
enDesc: The purple light from this wand will make the target run amok attacking random creatures in its vicinity.

zhDesc: 当这支法杖的冲击击中墙壁（或其他固体障碍）时，会引发一场石崩，对受影响区域内的所有生物造成伤害并使其眩晕。
enDesc: When a discharge of this wand hits a wall (or any other solid obstacle) it causes an avalanche of stones, damaging and stunning all creatures in the affected area.

zhDesc: 这支法杖能让你朝选定方向传送。生物和实体障碍会阻挡传送。
enDesc: This wand will allow you to teleport in the chosen direction. Creatures and inanimate obstructions will block the teleportation.

zhDesc: 这支法杖射出一道毁灭性能量束，穿透它路径上的所有生物。命中的目标越多，对每一个造成的伤害就越高。
enDesc: This wand emits a beam of destructive energy, which pierces all creatures in its way. The more targets it hits, the more damage it inflicts to each of them.

zhDesc: 这支法杖会喷发阵阵魔法火焰，能点燃可燃地形，并灼伤被它击中的生物。
enDesc: This wand unleashes bursts of magical fire. It will ignite flammable terrain, and will damage and burn a creature it hits.

zhDesc: 这是一只魔法绵羊。它哪里魔法了？你杀不死它。它会一直站在那里，直到魔法般地消失，全程面无表情地反刍着。
enDesc: This is a magic sheep. What's so magical about it? You can't kill it. It will stand there until it magcially fades away, all the while chewing cud with a blank stare.

zhDesc: 这支法杖召来致命的电弧，对彼此靠近的数个生物造成伤害。
enDesc: This wand conjures forth deadly arcs of electricity, which deal damage to several creatures standing close to each other.

zhDesc: 这支法杖发射纯粹魔力凝聚的飞弹，对目标生物造成中等伤害。
enDesc: This wand launches missiles of pure magical energy, dealing moderate damage to a target creature.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_WAND: 选择一支法杖进行升级
zhConsts.TXT_DISENCHANTED: 你分解了魔法飞弹法杖，用它的精华来升级你的%s

enConsts.TXT_DISENCHANTED: you disenchanted the Wand of Magic Missile and used its essence to upgrade your %s

zhDesc: 这截扭曲木头喷出的邪恶冲击会给目标注入致命毒液。中毒的生物会持续受到伤害，直到效果结束。效果持续时间随法杖等级提高而延长。
enDesc: The vile blast of this twisted bit of wood will imbue its target with a deadly venom. A creature that is poisoned will suffer periodic damage until the effect ends. The duration of the effect increases with the level of the staff.

zhDesc: 这支实用法杖可以隔空取物，还能与敌人交换位置。它辐射出的魔力波会影响沿途所有格子，触发陷阱、踩倒高草、打开关着的门、关上开着的门。
enDesc: This utility wand can be used to grab objects from a distance and to switch places with enemies. Waves of magic force radiated from it will affect all cells on their way triggering traps, trampling high vegetation, opening closed doors and closing open ones.

zhConsts.TXT_YOU_NOW_HAVE: 你用魔法把%s送进了自己的背包

enConsts.TXT_YOU_NOW_HAVE: You have magically transported %s into your backpack

zhDesc: 「生命终结之处，新的生命总会开始生长……永恒的循环永不停息！」
enDesc: "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"

zhDesc: 这支法杖会让一个生物以平时一半的速度移动和攻击，直到效果结束。
enDesc: This wand will cause a creature to move and attack at half its ordinary speed until the effect ends

zhDesc: 这支法杖的一击会把一个生物违背其意愿地传送到当前楼层的某个随机位置。
enDesc: A blast from this wand will teleport a creature against its will to a random place on the current level.

zhDesc: 很少有生物能扛住这座由铅与钢堆成的高塔砸下的粉碎一击，但也只有最强壮的冒险者才能挥动它。
enDesc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but only the strongest of adventurers can use it effectively.

zhDesc: 这套护甲看上去很笨重，却能让勇士朝指定位置施展「英勇跃击」，落地时震晕周围所有敌人。
enDesc: While this armor looks heavy, it allows a warrior to perform heroic leap towards a targeted location, slamming down to stun all neighbouring enemies.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_WARRIOR: 只有勇士能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_WARRIOR: Only warriors can use this armor!

zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: 不同种类魔法的相互作用抵消了这把武器上的附魔！

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: You are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: Interaction of different types of magic has negated the enchantment on this weapon!

zhDesc: 用配重石可以调整近战武器的平衡，提高它的攻速或命中。
enDesc: Using a weightstone, you can balance your melee weapon to increase its speed or accuracy.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_WEAPON: 选择一件武器进行配重
zhConsts.TXT_FAST: 你给%s配重，让它变得更快
zhConsts.TXT_ACCURATE: 你给%s配重，让它变得更准

enConsts.TXT_FAST: you balanced your %s to make it faster
enConsts.TXT_ACCURATE: you balanced your %s to make it more accurate
enConsts.TXT_CHOICE: How would you like to balance your %s?
